Name: Pyrotechnics
Description: A burst of flame and sparks blinds one enemy group. Requires a fire source such as Produce Flame or a torch. Causes no damage.
EffectDescription: Requires a fire source (an active Produce Flame or a torch/lantern carried by the party). One enemy group is blinded for 1 round per caster level, no save, and no damage is caused. Blinded attackers suffer -4 THAC0 against non-invisible targets. While the smoke and fireworks last, any attempt to run always succeeds.
